listen_addresses.description: IP address(es) or hostname(s) PostgreSQL will listen on. Use '*' to listen on all interfaces. Example: '127.0.0.1,::1'.

port.description: TCP port number for client connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed.

shared_buffers.description: Amount of memory dedicated to PostgreSQL for caching data. Format: '<number><unit>' (e.g., 256MB, 1GB).

wal_buffers.description: Amount of shared memory used for WAL data. Usually auto-tuned, but can be set explicitly.

checkpoint_completion_target.description: Fraction of checkpoint interval over which checkpoint writes are spread (0.0–1.0). Higher values reduce I/O spikes.

wal_segment_size.description: Size of each WAL segment file. Only change if recompiled with custom settings (rarely needed).

logging_collector.description: Enable the log collector to redirect log output into files instead of stderr.

log_directory.description: Directory where log files are stored. Must exist and be writable by the postgres user.

log_filename.description: Pattern for log filenames. Supports strftime-style placeholders (%Y, %m, %d, etc.).

log_min_messages.description: Threshold for messages written to the server log (e.g., DEBUG5, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, LOG).

log_min_duration_statement.description: Duration (in milliseconds) above which a statement will be logged. Set to -1 to disable.

log_timezone.description: Timezone used for timestamps in log messages. Prefer 'UTC' for consistency.

lc_messages.description: Locale for message language. Must match available locale on the system.

default_text_search_config.description: Default text search configuration for full-text search operations.

extra_settings.description: Additional key-value configuration settings. Each item is a pair of key (string) and value (string).

value.description: Value for the parameter (as it appears in postgresql.conf)
